games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Which genre uses talking animals as its main characters and always teaches a moral?
rounds.explanation: The green shelf holds fables; legends may also be old, but they do not always end with a clear moral.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence puts the comma in the right place?
choices: The trial began and, the room grew quiet.
The trial began, and the room grew quiet.
The trial, began and the room grew quiet.
The trial began and the room, grew quiet.
rounds.answer: The trial began, and the room grew quiet.
rounds.explanation: The word and joins two complete sentences here, so the comma goes immediately before it.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from part 1 of the story: "And this part says the rule was reviewed during a time of civil ______."
rounds.explanation: Civil unrest names a time when people are unhappy enough to protest, which is what Sami finds in the file.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: What does the word "illegible" mean?
choices: Very boring because it is always the same.
Able to be travelled on, especially by boats.
Not awake and not aware of what is happening.
Hard to read or not clear enough to understand.
rounds.answer: Hard to read or not clear enough to understand.
rounds.explanation: Legible means readable, so the prefix il- flips it: the faded files in the story were illegible.

rounds.prompt: Which prefix turns "complete" into a word meaning the opposite?
rounds.explanation: In- means not, so complete becomes incomplete; -ous and -able are endings, and re- means again.

rounds.prompt: Teacher Yasmin says one genre is built on suspense, real clues and false clues. Which genre is it?
rounds.explanation: The dark blue shelf holds mysteries, where the writer plants false clues to keep the reader guessing.
